spans.s:
यङ् यङ्, (in grammar) a term for the
syllable य, which is the sign of the Intensive.
—यङ्-अन्त, अस्, m. (in grammar) the Ātmane-
pada Intensive formed by reduplication and the
addition of the syllable य.
—यङ्-लुक्, the dropping
or omission of य (i. e. according to the theory of
grammarians a blank substituted for the य of the
Intensive).
—यङ्लुग्-अन्त, अस्, m. the Parasmai-
pada Intensive formed without य.
—यङ्लुग्-अन्त-
शिरोमणि, N. of a treatise on the Intensive without
य.
